title: Member satisfaction survey call input
description: Work item handed to the agent. The policyholder's name and risk tier are the only facts the agent brings to the call; everything else it says comes from the script and everything else it records comes from the member.

call_context.description: The frame around the call — which call this is, on what line, in whose name. None of it is survey content and none of it gates a question. Two fields are declared here but NOT yet acted on; each says so, because a work item that sets one and sees no effect is worse than one the schema never accepted.

call_id.description: The platform's identifier for this call, e.g. rcm-2026-02-01-0001. Carried for correlation; the agent neither reads nor speaks it.

agent_name.description: The name the caller introduces itself by. NOT yet spoken. The introduction is approved wording in data/msat_script.json and says 'Ida'; a work item naming anyone else is currently ignored rather than obeyed, because changing what the agent calls itself means changing an approved line.

phone_number.description: The number dialled for this attempt.

callback_number.description: A number the member could be given to call back on, e.g. 800-678-0920. NOT yet spoken: no approved line offers one, and the agent does not invent contact details.

attempt.description: Which attempt at this work item this call is.

language.description: BCP-47 tag, e.g. en-US. Recorded, not acted on — the script is transcribed in English only.

policyholder.description: Who we are calling. The risk tier decides whether question 5 is asked and is never inferred from anything the member says.

risk_tier.description: high = question 5 is asked; rising = it is skipped. Any other value, or none at all, and the question is skipped and reported as skipped.
